About Couple Better Gifts

Couple Better Gifts helps you choose a gift around someone’s interests and your budget. It started as a web-business project for a BYU–Idaho class.

How the quiz works

Set your budget, choose up to two interests, and tell us what kind of gift you have in mind. Gaming gifts get an extra compatibility question. You can skip a suggestion or change your answers.

How we choose gifts

The quiz matches your answers to a fixed catalog. It favors relevant interests and gift styles, then varies the types of items in your shortlist. Commission rates do not affect the ranking.

We research product details on retailer and manufacturer pages. Each result includes a buying check for details such as size, edition, compatibility, or personalization. Budget bands help you plan; check the store’s current price and checkout total.

AI helped build the website and draft the guides. We have not personally tested these products. The guides link to primary sources for technical details. We use product images only when we have permission.

Shopping links and advertising

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Amazon links may earn us a commission. Some open an exact listing; others open a labeled search.

We also link to Bookshop.org, LoveBook, Personalization Mall, Miniature Market, and Lovepop. Those currently use ordinary retailer links. Each result identifies the store and whether its link is an affiliate link. The buying guides include display advertising.

The retailer handles payment, delivery, returns, and order support. Check the selected version, delivery estimate, and return terms before ordering personalized products.

About the project

This is an independently run student project for adult shoppers buying gifts for people aged 13 and older. BYU–Idaho and the featured retailers have no role in running it.
